IMPORTANT: symbol PARQ = Swisstek (Ceylon) PLC (the CSE ticker was retained from the company's earlier name/listing history; confirmed via source_id 679 matching PARQ's own prior filings in this database, and via the cover page reading 'Swisstek (Ceylon) PLC'). Aluminium products + flooring/tile accessories manufacturer (subsidiaries: Swisstek Aluminium Ltd, Swisstek Development Ltd). operating_profit = 'Profit from operating activities' (499,456 Group / 177,112 Company). finance_costs/finance_income left as a net 'Net finance (cost)/Income' single line in the filing (149,264 net cost for Group, 4,236 net income for Company) -- recorded here under finance_costs (Group, since net is a cost) and finance_income (Company, since net is income) respectively, consistent with how this project has handled other filings that only disclose a single net financing line. short_term_borrowings = 'Long term borrowings payable within one year' + 'Short term loans' + 'Bank overdrafts'. long_term_borrowings = 'Long term borrowings payable after one year'. EPS cross-check: Group 220,531k/136,860,000 shares=1.612~=1.61 disclosed; Company 131,354k/136,860,000=0.960~=0.96 disclosed -- both tie. No column-swap issues in this filing (unlike some others processed this session). NOTE ON SEGMENTAL TABLE: the filing's own 'Segmental Information' table (p.3) prints its own Variance% column with an apparent SIGN ERROR -- it shows 'Consolidated profit/(loss) before tax ... -46.9%' and 'Aluminium products ... -93.5%' even though the underlying absolute figures clearly show INCREASES (PBT 350,192 vs 238,323; Aluminium PBT 170,400 vs 88,074) that match the +46.9% figure correctly signed elsewhere in the same filing's income statement. Treated as a printing/labelling glitch in the filing itself; the true direction (growth) is used in the narrative below, not the filing's mis-signed segmental label.

interim_updates.note_text: Swisstek (Ceylon) PLC's Group revenue grew 16.0% YoY to Rs.4.18bn for Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30 June 2026), with PBT up 46.9% to Rs.350.2mn and PAT up 55.2% to Rs.262.5mn. By segment, growth was driven overwhelmingly by Aluminium products (housed in subsidiary Swisstek Aluminium Ltd, ~69% of Group turnover): segment PBT nearly doubled to Rs.170.4mn from Rs.88.1mn (+93.5%), on turnover growth of 10.4% (Rs.2.62bn to Rs.2.89bn) -- a large margin improvement, not just volume growth. The Flooring and tile accessories segment (essentially the standalone Company) grew more modestly: turnover +30.8% (Rs.979.7mn to Rs.1.28bn) but segment PBT +19.7% (Rs.150.2mn to Rs.179.8mn), a slower profit growth rate than revenue growth, indicating some margin compression in this segment even as volumes grew strongly. At the standalone Company level (essentially the Flooring segment), Results from Operating Activities actually FELL 4.1% YoY (Rs.184.6mn to Rs.177.1mn) as Distribution expenses (+48.4%) and Administrative expenses (+110.0%) both grew much faster than the 30.2% gross profit growth -- a genuine operating-margin deterioration at the core flooring business. This was more than offset at the PBT line by a favourable swing in net finance income/cost (from a Rs.19.8mn net cost to a Rs.4.2mn net income), pushing Company PBT up 19.8% despite the operating decline.
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: no quarter closer to this one has been collected for PARQ -- this is the first financial_statements entry for this symbol. This filing's P&L table did not have the dual-rendering column-order ambiguity seen in some other filings processed this session (e.g. TILE); figures were read directly and verified via EPS/share-count with no discrepancies.
interim_updates.takeaway: Group-level growth (+47% PBT) is real but concentrated almost entirely in the Aluminium products segment (subsidiary), whose PBT nearly doubled on both volume and margin improvement. The core Flooring & tile accessories business (essentially the standalone Company) tells a more mixed story: strong revenue growth (+31%) but operating profit actually declined 4.1% as distribution and administrative costs outgrew gross profit -- Company-level PBT growth (+20%) depended on a favourable net finance swing, not core operating improvement.
operational_highlights: Group revenue +16.0% YoY to Rs.4.18bn; PBT +46.9% to Rs.350.2mn; PAT +55.2% to Rs.262.5mn
Aluminium products segment (subsidiary, ~69% of Group turnover): PBT nearly doubled to Rs.170.4mn from Rs.88.1mn (+93.5%) on turnover +10.4% -- the dominant driver of Group profit growth
Flooring and tile accessories segment: turnover +30.8% to Rs.1.28bn but segment PBT grew a slower +19.7% to Rs.179.8mn, indicating some margin compression despite strong volume growth

Standalone Company (essentially the Flooring segment): Results from Operating Activities FELL 4.1% YoY (Rs.184.6mn to Rs.177.1mn) as Distribution (+48.4%) and Administrative expenses (+110.0%) outgrew gross profit growth (+30.2%)
Company PBT still rose 19.8% despite the operating decline, cushioned by net finance income swinging from a Rs.19.8mn cost to a Rs.4.2mn income
A final dividend of Rs.0.40/share (Rs.54.7mn) for FY2025/26 was approved 30 June 2026 and paid 20 July 2026
key_drivers: Aluminium products segment PBT +93.5% YoY (Rs.88.1mn to Rs.170.4mn) is the single largest driver of Group profit growth -- both volume (turnover +10.4%) and margin expansion contributed

Flooring and tile accessories segment PBT growth (+19.7%) lagged its own turnover growth (+30.8%), a margin-compression signal in the core business, consistent with the standalone Company's operating-profit decline

Company-level Administrative expenses more than doubled YoY (+110.0%, Rs.49.5mn to Rs.103.9mn) -- the single largest driver of the Company's operating-profit decline, though the underlying cause is not itemised in this filing
A favourable swing in net finance income/cost (Company: -Rs.19.8mn to +Rs.4.2mn) masked the Company-level operating decline at the PBT line -- a non-operating driver of the reported PBT growth
